# Poker Sharingan

Open-source Rust reproduction of the Pluribus method for six-player no-limit hold'em.

- [Source](https://github.com/markokraemer/poker-sharingan)
- [Run locally](https://sharingan.poker/docs/)
- [SHARINGAN-2 weights](https://huggingface.co/markokraemer/sharingan-2)
- [SHARINGAN-1 weights](https://huggingface.co/markokraemer/sharingan-1)
- [Agent workflow](https://sharingan.poker/skill.md)
- [Method](https://github.com/markokraemer/poker-sharingan/blob/main/docs/METHOD.md)
- [Evaluation](https://github.com/markokraemer/poker-sharingan/blob/main/docs/EVALUATION.md)

Both models have known exploitable weaknesses. Detailed measurements and limitations
are in docs/RESULTS.md; do not claim unexploitable play.
